name: HeyForm
description: Open source conversational form builder for surveys, quizzes, and lead capture forms.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      MONGO_URI: "mongodb://{{serviceName}}-mongo:27017/heyform"
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      REDIS_PORT: 6379
      SESSION_KEY: {{env.SESSION_KEY}}
      FORM_ENCRYPTION_KEY: {{env.FORM_ENCRYPTION_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/app/upload
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-mongo:
    image: mongo:6
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
